The Conservancy is the owner of certainreal property in Laramie County, Wyoming,
consisting of1800 acres, more orless, more particularly described and shown in ExhibitsA andB
attached hereto and incorporated herein by this reference (the“Property").
B.
The Property currently remains in a substantially undisturbed, natural state and has
significant ecological and open-space values and provides significant relatively natural habitat for
native plants andwildlife.
C.
Protection of the Property will contribute to the conservation of important significant
relatively natural habitat for wildlife and plants, including particularly native foothills grasslands,
mountain mag any kuku shu mac and rabbit bru hb lan, r, anlost
raptors, migratory and breeding birds and mammals (the“Conservation Values").In addition, the
Property harbors scenic and agricultural values worthy of protection.
D.
The Property lies adjacent to the Red Mountain Ranch-Colorado, a property owned
and managed as open space by Larimer County, Colorado, and opportunity exists for cooperative
and compatible management across the state boundary line, facilitating landscape-scale
conservation.

consistent with the Conservation Values protected here in.
